note: VIA Rail Canada routes with sleeping accommodations (cabins / berths). VIA names GTFS routes by city pair and bilingually (e.g. 'Montréal - Halifax'), so exact-name matching is brittle — these are matched by terminal-station city pair instead (order-independent, accent-folded), which is robust to feed naming. Corridor day trains and the sleeper-less Skeena (Jasper - Prince Rupert, hotel overnight) are intentionally excluded. Entries may be either a { from, to } city pair or a plain route-name string.
